title: All-hands Sept 2026 - Q3 review + Q4 priorities (draft)
content:
Purpose: draft of CEO + product talking points, high-level Q&A, and slide checklist for the Sept all-hands.

Notes to self:
- This is a scratch draft - send to Samira and Jordan for edits before styling slides.
- Keep slides to ~18min talk from CEO, 10min product, 7min metrics, 5-7min customer story, 15-20min Q&A.
- Need one line for customer privacy / Private offering update.

Topline messages (short):
1) We shipped Redwood Dedicated GA in Aug - early customers are seeing 20-30% lower p95 latency after tuning (draft metric, validate with infra).
2) Hosted API growth remains strong: 18% m/m active apps (double-check analytics).
3) Q4 focus: reliability (SLOs), cost-optimization tooling (Optimize beta), and Private deployments for regulated customers.

CEO talking points (Olivia: tailor voice to Erik):
- Quick thanks + culture callout (new hires, London office launch).
- Celebrate serving-runtime team for Dedicated GA and smooth rollouts (call out lead: Maya Garcia).
- Business momentum: usage growth, a few mid-market deals, and improving unit economics.
- Focus for Q4: bring reliability to enterprise parity, make Dedicated predictable & easy to onboard, and ship first private-customer POC.
- Ask for help: keep filing edge cases in #prod-issues, and prioritize customer-impacting bugs.

Product lead (Jordan Chen) - draft script:
- Short demo, 2 slides: Dedicated GA highlights + Optimize beta.
- Show before/after of latency & cost for a representative workload (placeholder numbers: 25% cost reduction using batching + quantization).
- Roadmap bullets: autoscaling improvements, rollout APIs, canary metrics, and per-route tracing in Console.

Metrics slide (SRE / Growth):
- Active apps (hosted): _TBD_ (ask growth analytics before Monday).
- Avg p95 latency (hosted): _TBD_.
- Dedicated utilization: target vs actual (need numbers from infra).
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): trending down - show trend line if available.

Customer story (5-7min):
- Customer: AcmeHealth (placeholder) - highlight Private POC underway.
- Value: data isolation + predictable latency for triage workflows.
- Ask: include customer quote if legal can sign off by EOW. (Linked artifact: JIRA-9876 customer-legal-review)

Anticipated Q&A (prep answers):
Q: "When will Dedicated pricing be finalized?"
A: "We'll publish standard pricing after we finalize the autoscaling/burst policy in Oct; early-customers keep committed discounts (sales will follow up)."

Q: "How do we compare to X cloud vendor on latency?"
A: "Short answer: depends on workload - our benchmarks show competitive p50/p95 on common configs; public benchmark link will be posted after we validate with engineering and legal."

Q: "Any layoffs or hiring freeze?"
A: "No. We're prioritizing hires for infra and sales motions aligned to Dedicated & Private; other hiring will be evaluated quarter-by-quarter."

Q: "What's the plan for model support (open models vs commercial)?"
A: "We'll continue to add vetted open models and provide verified performance profiles - product will publish the model catalog update in Oct."

Unresolved / TODOs (action items):
- [Olivia] Finalize CEO script with Erik by 2026-09-17 EOD.
- [Jordan] Provide verified metrics for latency & cost (hosted + Dedicated) by 2026-09-16.
- [Maya] Confirm Dedicated early-customer quote and send to legal for approval (JIRA-9876).
- [Samira] Draft email announcement to customers + opt-in for Dedicated private preview (copy by 2026-09-18).
- [Design] Build 5 slides (title, topline, product, metrics, customer story) - ask for deck template in #internal-design.

Slide checklist (quick):
- Title slide: All-hands - Sept 2026 (Erik)
- Topline slide: 3 bullets (business momentum)
- Product slide(s): Dedicated GA summary + Optimize beta status
- Metrics slide: visuals for active apps, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens
- Customer slide: AcmeHealth POC status + quote
- Q&A slide: link to post-meeting feedback form (Google Form)

Tone + style notes:
- Keep it upbeat but honest (call out outages and follow-ups).
- Avoid deep technical jargon in CEO remarks; allow product to surface technical highlights.
- For customer-sensitive numbers, mark as internal-only.

Links and refs (scratch):
- Q3 roadmap (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Q3-Roadmap
- Dedicated GA release notes (internal doc): /shared_drives/engineering/dedicated/dedicated-ga-notes (ask release-eng for final path)
- JIRA tickets: JIRA-1234 (Dedicated GA followups), JIRA-9876 (AcmeHealth legal)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987 (console rollout UI)

Open questions for leadership:
- Should we publicly announce Dedicated GA or do a staged customer announcement? (Pros/cons: marketing buzz vs risk of early bugs)
- Any specific customer to highlight for the story (we have 2 possibilities: AcmeHealth or FinServCo).

Draft email blurb for customers (very rough):
Subject: "Redwood Dedicated is GA - predictable performance, private capacity"
Body first line: "Today we're excited to announce the GA launch of Redwood Dedicated, our reserved capacity product for customers who need predictable performance and data isolation. Early customers are already seeing latency improvements and easier rollouts. Learn more in the product update."

Notes-to-self:
- This doc will become the basis for the speaker notes and the internal Slack post.
- After approvals, create a condensed 3-4 bullet summary for the #announce channel.

End of draft.

(If you're editing: please add inline comments rather than rewriting - helps track changes.)
